mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month indicates an easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation models and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% over the past two months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production exceeding 0.3% over the past month signals an imminent slowdown in manufacturing activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.3% during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the signal in the late-cycle regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month growth in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS grows by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt a tighter monetary policy stance, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% month-over-month) and rising unemployment (UNRATE increase > 0.2pp) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% over the past month indicates a potential setback in the housing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines > 0.5% during early-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the signal in the early-cycle regime is below 0.03.
